topPicks.editorialNote:
**Editorial Note:**

Euston progress directly impacts Old Oak Common—our interchange is key to the wider corridor. We should clarify: which three fronts? How does this timeline affect our Local Plan targets (19,850 homes by 2038)? Request HS2 Ltd comment on Old Oak delivery milestones and job creation timelines. Verify against latest West London spatial strategy.
